description: Private messaging, no servers. Your data stays on your devices, synced peer-to-peer. AI-enhanced, self-improving, and fully under your control.

features.title: Local-first
features.short: Your data never leaves your device unless you choose to sync
features.detail: Offline-capable — works without internet, syncs when connected

features.title: End-to-end encrypted
features.short: AEAD encryption (Argon2 keys) with HPKE-wrapped conversation keys
features.detail: AEAD + HPKE (RFC 9180) — not even we can read your messages

features.title: Decentralized
features.short: No servers, powered by the Veilid network (DHT)
features.detail: No servers — identity and data live on the Veilid DHT

features.title: Conflict-free sync
features.short: Cross-device sync — conflict-free merging via Automerge CRDTs
features.detail: CRDT-based sync queue with retry and dead letter recovery

features.title: Time Travel
features.short: Automatic backups with point-in-time restore for your data
features.detail: CRDT compaction creates automatic snapshots — browse history and restore deleted items

features.title: Smart compression
features.short: Zstd compression — level 22 with trained dictionaries for minimal bandwidth
features.detail: Trained Zstd dictionaries that improve over time

features.title: Native speed
features.short: Multi-platform — Web, Desktop, Mobile from a single codebase (Dioxus)
features.detail: Built in Rust — iOS, Android, Desktop, and Web

features.title: Agentic AI
features.short: Coming soon: on-device AI agents that work for you, privately
features.detail: Coming soon — on-device AI agents that work for you, privately

features.title: Self-improving
features.short: Periodic recompression and optimization in the background
features.detail: Periodic recompression and optimization in the background
